The '''Umbara capital city''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] it was the site of a [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|massive battle]]. During the battle, the city was resupplied from a nearby [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|airfield]] until the airbase was captured by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].<ref name="Darkness" />

==History==
In [[3629 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.4}}</ref> a [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] carrying [[Adegan crystal/Legends|adegan crystals]] heading towards the capital was [[Crisis on Umbara|hijacked]] by [[Theron Shan]], who was working undercover for the [[Eternal Alliance]] while pretending to serve the [[Order of Zildrog]]. The hovertrain crashed on route to the capital and most its surviving security team members were killed shortly afterwards by native wildlife.<ref name="Crisis">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|Crisis on Umbara}}</ref>

The city served as the capital of Umbara during the Clone Wars. At one point, the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]] decided to defect to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which prompted an attack on Umbara by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces. The capital was a major battlefield, being defended by the [[Umbaran militia]]. It was supplied during the battle by a nearby airbase, before the base was captured by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the 501st Legion.<ref name="Darkness" /> [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], commanding the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]], eventually conquered the capital and held it, thus securing Republic victory on Umbara.<ref name="Carnage">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>
